description: Directory listing d-tag derivation (SPEC §8.2.1). d-tag = 'oc-lock-chat-dir:' || base64url(SHA-256('oc-lock-chat-dir/v1:' || lower(handle))), unpadded. Salted-handle hash so the directory is lookup-by-known-handle, never enumerate-all — the d-tag reveals nothing about the handle to a relay that only stores it.
notes: handle is lowercased before hashing. base64url is unpadded. Reproduce with: 'oc-lock-chat-dir:' + base64url(sha256(utf8('oc-lock-chat-dir/v1:'+handle))).
